scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the 2 by 2 upper triangular ring over a finite field. Its proof is symbolic and does not rely on the finite verification. The closest clean-index paper studies ordinary clean idempotents without a commutation requirement, while the closest uniquely-strongly-clean paper gives ring-level uniqueness criteria rather than the finite-field elementwise multiplicity distribution. No claim is made for higher triangular size.
title: Strongly clean multiplicity profile of \(2\times2\) triangular matrices over finite fields
